content: भागः [भज् भावे घञ्] .²1 A part, portion, share, division; as in भागहर, भागशः <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Allotment, distribution, partition. .²3 Lot, fate; निर्माणभागः परिणतः <ls>U. 4</ls>. .²4 A part of any whole, a fraction. .²5 The numerator of a fraction. .²6 A quarter, one-fourth part. .²7 A degree or the 360th part of the circumference of a circle. .²8 The 30th part of a zodiacal sign. .²9 The quotient. .²10 Room, space, spot, region, place; अयनेषु च सर्वेषु यथाभागमवस्थिताः <ls>Bg. 1. 11</ls>; <ls>R. 18. 47</ls>. .²11 A portion payable to Government; सीता, भागो, बलिः, करो … … राष्ट्रम् <ls>Kau. A. 2. 6. 24</ls>. .²12 One of the four contentments (<ab>Sāṅ. Phil.</ab>); आध्यात्मिकाश्चतस्रः प्रकृत्युपादानकालभागाख्याः (<ab>v. l.</ab> भाग्याख्याः) <ls>Sāṅ. K. 50</ls>. .²13 A half-rupee. .²14 The number eleven.
